overview.purpose_zh: 把五个城市的配送时间画成一层层山脊，用曲线的高低和宽窄比较形状：峰在哪、两边拖多长、哪些区间重叠得最多。
works_zh: 五个以上分组一起比较分布形状
看城市之间的重叠区间和各自的尾巴
在不逐个读数的情况下，判断哪个城市整体更慢
uses_zh: 区域运营汇报里一页看完五个城市的时效形状
定价或时效承诺前，确认城市之间是整体差异还是尾部差异
给非技术同事解释“中位数接近”不代表“体验一样”

understanding.read_zh: 先看横轴，越往右越慢；每一层是一条曲线，曲线高表示订单在那一带很密集，低表示稀少。比较城市时看峰的位置、两侧的坡度和平缓的尾巴，不要用手指去抠精确的中位数，那是箱线图更擅长的事。

elements.note_zh: 每一层左边写着城市名，五层上下叠放。
曲线的高矮表示那个时长附近订单有多密集，不是某一笔订单的数值。
每条曲线最高的位置，代表最常见的时长区间。
几条曲线同时有高度的那一段，说明这些城市在这段时长里表现接近。
横向的分钟刻度；五层共用同一把尺子。

look_for_zh: 哪条曲线的峰最靠右，哪个城市整体更慢
哪条曲线右侧拖得最长，哪个城市有慢单的风险
哪些曲线在中间几乎叠在一起，哪些只在尾巴上分开

observations.en: Guangzhou's ridge sits furthest right, with its peak near 39 minutes.
observations.zh: 广州的山脊最靠右，峰大约在 39 分钟。

observations.en: Hangzhou's ridge peaks lowest and furthest left; half of its orders arrive within 34 minutes.
observations.zh: 杭州的峰最低也最靠左；它有一半订单在 34 分钟内送达。

observations.en: The five curves overlap heavily between 30 and 40 minutes, so the cities differ more at the edges than in the middle.
observations.zh: 五条曲线在 30 到 40 分钟之间大量重叠，所以城市之间的差别更多在两端，而不是中间。

observations.en: Above 55 minutes, only Guangzhou, Beijing and Chengdu still have orders.
observations.zh: 超过 55 分钟之后，只剩广州、北京和成都还有订单。

observations.en: Shanghai and Hangzhou almost coincide, with peaks one minute apart.
observations.zh: 上海和杭州几乎重合，两个峰只差 1 分钟。

describe.en: The ridgeline chart illustrates how delivery times are distributed across five cities.
describe.zh: 这张山脊图说明五个城市的配送时长分布。
describe.pattern: The graph illustrates + how + noun + is distributed across + groups
alternatives: The chart illustrates the distribution of delivery times in five cities.
The chart compares the shape of delivery times across five cities.
describe.note_zh: 开头点明“比较形状”，不要只说“显示数据”。

describe.en: Each ridge shows the distribution of 12 orders from one city.
describe.zh: 每一层山脊表示一个城市 12 笔订单的分布。
describe.pattern: each ridge shows the distribution of + number of items + from + group
alternatives: Each curve summarizes the distribution of 12 orders.
Every city's distribution is drawn as its own ridge.
describe.note_zh: 先交代一层代表多少笔订单，读者才知道曲线的光滑程度是怎么来的。

describe.en: Every curve is right-skewed: the side toward slower deliveries stretches further than the fast side.
describe.zh: 每条曲线都向右偏：朝慢单那一侧拖得比快单一侧更长。
alternatives: All five distributions are skewed to the right.
The curves lean right: their slow tails are longer than their fast tails.
describe.note_zh: 右偏看的是尾巴的方向，不是山峰偏在哪边。

describe.en: The concentration of orders is highest between 30 and 40 minutes, where all five curves reach their peak.
describe.zh: 订单最集中在 30 到 40 分钟之间，五条曲线都在这一段到达各自的峰。
describe.pattern: the concentration of + noun + is highest between + value + and + value
alternatives: Orders concentrate between 30 and 40 minutes in every city.
The densest part of each curve sits between 30 and 40 minutes.
describe.note_zh: concentration 要指出集中在哪一段，否则信息不完整。

describe.en: Guangzhou's delivery times are generally higher than those in the other four cities, and its curve sits furthest right.
describe.zh: 广州的配送时长整体高于其他四个城市，曲线也最靠右。
alternatives: Guangzhou sits to the right of the other four cities.
Among the five curves, Guangzhou's is the furthest right.
describe.note_zh: 比较曲线位置也可以说 further right，不要用 bigger，曲线本身没有大小。

describe.en: The most noticeable feature is how much the five curves overlap between 30 and 45 minutes.
describe.zh: 最引人注意的是五条曲线在 30 到 45 分钟之间大量重叠。
describe.pattern: The most noticeable feature is + noun phrase
alternatives: What is most noticeable is the overlap between 30 and 45 minutes.
The most striking feature is how closely the five curves match in the middle.
describe.note_zh: 重叠是山脊图最重要的信息之一，别只盯着各自的峰。

describe.en: Delivery times vary from 22 minutes in Hangzhou to 66 minutes in Guangzhou.
describe.zh: 配送时长从杭州的 22 分钟到广州的 66 分钟不等。
alternatives: The cities' delivery times range from 22 to 66 minutes.
Delivery times vary widely across the five cities.
describe.note_zh: vary from ... to ... 适合横向比城市，不表示同一个城市在时间里上下波动。

academic.en: The ridgeline chart stacks five density curves on one delivery-time axis, one curve for each city. A single peak is visible on every curve between the low 30s and the late 30s, and all five curves overlap across the middle of the range. Hangzhou's curve is positioned furthest left and Guangzhou's furthest right. The principal differences lie in the upper tails: Hangzhou's slowest order is 52 minutes, whereas Guangzhou's reaches 66, with Beijing and Chengdu at 61 and 60 respectively.
academic.zh: 山脊图在同一根配送时间轴上叠了五条密度曲线，每个城市一条。每条曲线都在 30 分钟出头到接近 40 分钟之间有一个峰，五条曲线在区间中段大量重叠。杭州的曲线最靠左，广州的最靠右。差别主要出现在慢的一侧：杭州最慢的订单是 52 分钟，广州达到 66 分钟，北京和成都分别是 61 分钟和 60 分钟。

business.en: Our five cities look alike in the middle and different at the edge. Most orders in all five arrive between 30 and 45 minutes, so the typical customer experience is consistent. The risk is in the slow tail: only Guangzhou, Beijing and Chengdu still have orders above 55 minutes, and Guangzhou alone reaches 66. One national promise covers the middle well, but Guangzhou needs a slower peak-time estimate of its own. We should publish that separate estimate before the next peak period.
business.zh: 我们这五个城市在中间段很像，差别在边缘。五个城市里，大多数订单都在 30 到 45 分钟之间送达，所以常见体验是一致的。风险在慢的那条尾巴上：超过 55 分钟后，只有广州、北京和成都还有订单，而且只有广州能到 66 分钟。一个全国统一的承诺可以覆盖中间这一段，但广州在高峰时段需要单独给一个更慢的预估。我们应该在下一个高峰期之前把这个单独的预估公布出来。

simple.en: Each curve is one city's delivery times. The curves rise in the same spot, between 30 and 40 minutes, so most orders feel about the same. The difference is at the slow end. Hangzhou's slowest order is 52 minutes. Beijing's is 61, Chengdu's is 60, and Guangzhou's is 66. Guangzhou's curve also sits furthest to the right.
simple.zh: 每条曲线是一个城市的配送时间。曲线都在同一个地方升高，也就是 30 到 40 分钟这一段，所以大多数订单的感觉差不多。差别在慢的那一头。杭州最慢的订单是 52 分钟，北京是 61 分钟，成都是 60 分钟，广州是 66 分钟。广州的曲线也最靠右。

language_notes.body_zh: 描述山脊形状常用三个位置：peak 是最高点，shoulder 是峰旁边缓下来的肩部，tail 是拖出去的长尾。说形状时先讲峰，再讲尾巴，读者最容易跟得上。
examples: Guangzhou's curve peaks in the late 30s.
Its right shoulder stretches to 66 minutes.

language_notes.title_en: overlap is not the same as identical
language_notes.body_zh: overlap 说的是两条曲线在同一段时长里都有订单，不代表分布一样。重叠只说明中间部分接近，两端的尾巴可能完全不同，所以写完 overlap 还要补一句差别在哪。
examples: All five curves overlap between 30 and 45 minutes.
Overlap in the middle does not mean the cities are identical at the slow end.

language_notes.title_en: the peak is not the median
language_notes.body_zh: 曲线的峰是订单最密集的时长，中位数是排在正中间的那一单。广州的峰在 39 分钟左右，中位数约 43 分钟，两个数不一样。山脊图用来比形状，要精确读数就用箱线图。
examples: Guangzhou's peak sits near 39 minutes, but its middle order takes about 43 minutes.
A ridgeline shows shape; use a box plot for exact quartiles.
